The expression \((1+2i)6 - 3i\) follows standard order of operations: multiplication is performed before subtraction.

\[
(1+2i) \times 6 = 6 + 12i
\]

Then subtract \(3i\):
\[
6 + 12i - 3i = 6 + 9i
\]

Answer: 6+9i
